title: Taken in broad daylight in 2007

tellings.quote: was in the broad daylight. Then they came and they took me.

plain: A North Carolina man named Chris Bledsoe, author of the book UFO of God, says that in 2007, near the Cape Fear River in North Carolina, beings came and took him in broad daylight. He tells it as something that happened to him: "Then they came and they took me." If true, it would mean such abductions do not only happen in the dark.
